passage.text: Booha arrives early and helps prepare the classroom. He puts a notebook and textbook on each desk, then places every chair in a straight line. Nuppi writes the morning message on the whiteboard with a blue marker. Mister Happy checks the projector and computer while Mimo carries rulers, scissors, and glue from the locker. Before the bell rings, Booha finds an eraser under a pencil case and drops some paper in the trash can. The room is ready just as the students arrive.

comprehension.q: What does Booha put on each desk?
Where do the rulers come from?

writingPrompt.en: Write 1–3 sentences about preparing a classroom using notebook and projector.

passage.text: Booha receives a new school timetable and studies it carefully. On Monday he has Japanese, English, math, and science. Social studies comes after lunch, and the class compares history with geography. On Tuesday, PE and health teach the students how to care for their bodies. Music and art give Booha a chance to create, while home economics teaches useful skills for daily life. In ICT, he makes a simple program. Homeroom is where the class shares news, and club activities begin after the last lesson.

comprehension.q: Which subjects come before social studies on Monday?
What does Booha make in ICT?

writingPrompt.jp: favorite subject と club activities を つかって、じぶんの がっこうを 1〜3ぶんで かいてね。
writingPrompt.en: Write 1–3 sentences about school using favorite subject and club activities.

passage.text: A new student gets lost on the first morning of school, so Booha introduces the people who can help. The homeroom teacher shows her the classroom, and a subject teacher explains the science schedule. The librarian helps her find an English book. Later, the school nurse checks a small scratch while the counselor listens to her worries. In the hall, the janitor repairs a loose door and the security guard watches the entrance. The principal and vice principal welcome her at assembly. By lunchtime, a classmate, an upperclassman, and an underclassman have all said hello.

comprehension.q: Who helps the student find an English book?
Why does the student visit the school nurse?

writingPrompt.jp: librarian と counselor を つかって、がっこうで たすけてもらう ばめんを 1〜3ぶんで かいてね。
writingPrompt.en: Write 1–3 sentences about getting help at school using librarian and counselor.

passage.text: Booha reads the timetable so his busy school day will run smoothly. The first period starts after the morning assembly and the bell announces each change. During break, he prepares for the next class; during lunch break, he talks with Mimo. After school, they attend a club meeting before a parent meeting begins in another room. An exam is planned for Friday, but a holiday moves one lesson to a make-up class. Booha writes every start time and finish time in his schedule. Because he checks it carefully, he arrives on time all day.

comprehension.q: What announces each change in the school day?
Why does Booha arrive on time?
